newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi index falls on investor indifference.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi index falls on investor indifference.

text.p: Investor indifference continued at the Nairobi Stock Exchange on Friday, where the 20-share index fell as a current see-saw trend persisted, brokers said.
The index fell 12.56 points to stand at 3060.88. Turnover jumped to 21.653 million shillings on 797,811 shares compared to 14.669 million shares on 389,498 shares on Thursday.
"Investors are a little indifferent at the moment. Interest has been diverted for some time to the money markets while investors await any real market-driving news," a broker said.

The market reserved no applause for Kenya Commercial Bank Ltd, whose executive chairman Alexander Kaminchia said that the government would free another 10 percent of its holdings through the Nairobi Stock Exchange from September 16.
The government has a 70 percent shareholding in the bank while 30 percent is held by the public through the bourse.
Kenya Commercial Bank dropped to 55 from 57 on 4,747 shares. Floor dealers said it was still too early to expect investor reaction to Kaminchia's statement and put their bets on next week.
A broker described Friday as busy, with big lots dealt on the special board while many other small lots were dealt in the foreign investors board and the general trading floor.
Shares of National Bank of Kenya and Kenya Breweries were well traded on the special board.
Kenya Breweries traded 105,580 shares at 53 shillings from 47.25 while foreign investors dealt 103,501 shares of National Bank of Kenya.
In total, National Bank traded 508,051 shares at at varying prices of 18.50, 17.80 and 18.45 from 17.50 on Thursday.
Brokers said National Bank was the main attraction in Friday trading, attracting both local and foreign buyers. High demand forced prices higher, they added.
Among commercials, Nation Printers & Publishers rose 0.6 but fell back to 104, Uchumi Supermarket fell to 39.25 from 40 while Kenya Airways traded a total of 85,251 shares at 11.25 from 11.10.
Foreign investors traded 39,857 shares at 11.25, 2,018 shares at 11.20 and 1,210 shares at 11.10 of Kenya Airways.
British American Tobacco fell to 68 from 69.50.
